name: IDPhotoCraft
tagline: Professional ID photos — entirely on your device
description: IDPhotoCraft is an on-device ID, passport, and visa photo maker by MTP CODE. Capture or pick a photo, align with face detection, replace the background, apply country format presets, export high-quality results, and build print sheets — all processed locally on your Android device. Package ID: com.mtpcode.idphotocraft.
features: On-device face detection and framing guidance
Automatic background removal and solid-color replacement
Passport, visa, Aadhaar, and ID format presets with DPI control
Editor tools for crop, alignment, brightness, and polish
Print sheet layout for home or shop printing
Save favorite sizes, resume drafts, and share exports straight to WhatsApp
Photos never uploaded by the app — processing stays on device
Free tier with Google AdMob banners (Pro ad-free unlock coming soon via Google Play Billing)

notes: Submitted to Google Play Production for review
Android Photo Picker — no broad gallery permission required
Print sheet with real paper proportions (A4, A5, 4x6in, Letter)
Favorite sizes, resume drafts, and WhatsApp share after export
Data deletion link added to Settings and Privacy Policy
